closed_primitives.architecture-progression-v1: Mask-side fine-label transition and native-pattern/lumen postconditions are implemented and tested; frozen-generator architecture response and pathology review are not yet validated.
closed_primitives.neoplastic-cell-infiltration-increase-v1: Deprecated ambiguous primitive. Use neoplastic-microinfiltration-increase-v1, invasive-front-expansion-v1, structural-void-spread-v1 or architecture-progression-v1.
closed_primitives.structural-void-spread-v1: Void-aware complete-instance containment and separation are implemented and tested; digest-bound native airspace/alveolar inputs and frozen-generator STAS response are not yet validated.
closed_primitives.tumor-burden-decrease-v1: A growth mechanism cannot be inverted into treatment response or regression. This primitive remains closed until a domain-specific, evidence-backed response mechanism and frozen-generator capability are validated.

closed_mechanisms.breast-cohesive-nst-front: Breast execution no longer asks a general visual LLM to recognize a histologic invasive front. Use breast-annotation-anchored-boundary-growth or breast-infiltrative-nest-cord-extension.
closed_mechanisms.breast-discohesive-single-file: Breast execution no longer asks a general visual LLM to diagnose single-file morphology. Use breast-peritumoral-neoplastic-scatter for the mask-executable cell-only representation.
closed_mechanisms.colorectal-gland-forming-front: GLaS lacks explicit stromal authority and the attempted H&E/mask-derived gland-unit producer could not reliably distinguish lumen, mucin, necrosis and cleft. Keep tissue-level malignant-gland growth closed.
closed_mechanisms.lung-acinar-papillary-growth: IGNITE does not provide a digest-bound lumen or fibrovascular-core map. Acinar/papillary identity cannot be inferred from H&E because execution planning is mask-only.
closed_mechanisms.lung-lepidic-growth: IGNITE does not provide a digest-bound alveolar framework map. Lepidic growth cannot be executed without risking airspace filling, and H&E inference is prohibited.
closed_mechanisms.lung-local-tumor-clearance: The cross-validation annotation bundle has no user-supplied, digest-bound local_clearance_roi; automatic ROI invention would not be a mask-authorized local clearance.
closed_mechanisms.lung-stas-airspace-spread: STAS requires explicit alveolar/airspace authority. The current IGNITE bundle has no digest-bound airspace map, so mask-only execution must fail closed.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-discohesive-junctional: PUMA epidermis labels do not identify a junctional melanoma component. Junctional/pagetoid spread cannot be inferred from H&E by the execution Planner; use the non-diagnostic Tumor-Stroma peritumoral-focus mechanism instead.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-local-tumor-clearance: The cross-validation annotation bundle has no user-supplied, digest-bound local_clearance_roi; automatic ROI invention would not be mask-authorized local clearance.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-annotation-anchored-cord-extens: ORCA Other tissue is a heterogeneous non-carcinoma class and cannot certify a physiologically valid receiving substrate for an invasive cord without prohibited H&E interpretation.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-cohesive-nest-cord: ORCA Other tissue is a heterogeneous non-carcinoma class. A mask-only Planner cannot guarantee that boundary expansion preserves mucosa, muscle, salivary tissue, nerves and vessels.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-dispersed-invasive-front: ORCA Other tissue cannot identify a safe stromal invasive front. Placing carcinoma nuclei outside Tumor would risk mucosa, muscle, salivary, nerve or vascular compartments that are not encoded.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-local-carcinoma-clearance: The cross-validation annotation bundle has no user-supplied, digest-bound local_clearance_roi, and ORCA has no specific receiving stroma label.
closed_mechanisms.oral-scc-operational-tumor-retreat: ORCA has no explicit stroma or treatment-bed class. Tumor-to-Other-tissue replacement would overclaim post-treatment physiology from a heterogeneous annotation label.
closed_mechanisms.prostate-pattern-3-growth: The current generic interface-band executor cannot insert separated complete pattern-3 glands and has produced gland bridging or circumferential wall thickening. Keep this mechanism closed until a whole-gland-unit executor and paired frozen-generator validation exist.
closed_mechanisms.melanoma-intratumoral-necrosis-turnover: None of the 189 PUMA cross-validation targets has both the required Tumor-Necrosis contact and the 8% visible donor compartment for appearance or resolution. Both primitives are unavailable under the current annotation distribution.
